Normally I don't watch this kind of Turkish comedies. When I played the movie , wife told me ; you must be kidding:( I was going to watch only the start but Finished it with lots of laughs. Simple story but smart jokes very different characters and pretty good acting. In many Turkish comedies, there are smart-ass actors who try to make viewers laugh, hurting the others around. However this one is not one of them. Watch it with a partner.
